theme: 教材片語・中高階 750–850 第 30 群

items.colloc: annual sales figure 年度銷售額 | check the sales figure 檢查銷售數據
items.distinct: sales volume 銷售量 | sales revenue 銷售營收
ex: Please update the latest sales figure for the team.
請為團隊更新最新的銷售數據。
The sales figure for this quarter exceeded our expectations.
本季的銷售額超出了我們的預期。
Managers are reviewing the sales figure from last month.
經理們正在檢視上個月的銷售數據。

items.colloc: give a sales presentation 進行銷售簡報 | prepare a sales presentation 準備銷售簡報
items.distinct: marketing presentation 行銷簡報 | product demonstration 產品演示
ex: She gave a compelling sales presentation to the client.
她為客戶進行了一場引人入勝的銷售簡報。
We need to prepare a professional sales presentation today.
我們今天需要準備一份專業的銷售簡報。
The sales presentation focuses on our new service features.
這場銷售簡報著重於我們的新服務特色。

items.colloc: submit a sales report 提交銷售報告 | analyze the sales report 分析銷售報告
items.distinct: financial report 財務報告 | progress report 進度報告
ex: The sales report is due by the end of Friday.
銷售報告要在週五下班前繳交。
I have analyzed the monthly sales report for accuracy.
我已經分析過這份月度銷售報告的準確性。
Could you send me the sales report for this region?
你可以寄給我這區的銷售報告嗎？

items.colloc: consider the secondary effect 考慮次要影響 | mitigate the secondary effect 減輕次要影響
items.distinct: primary effect 主要影響 | side effect 副作用
ex: We must consider the secondary effect of this policy change.
我們必須考慮這項政策變動的次要影響。
The new tax law had a significant secondary effect on trade.
新稅法對貿易產生了顯著的間接影響。
They are investigating the secondary effect of the market slump.
他們正在調查市場蕭條的次要影響。

items.colloc: see if we can 看看我們是否能 | see if it is 看看它是否是
items.distinct: see whether 看看是否（較正式） | check if 確認是否
ex: Let me see if the manager is available now.
讓我看看經理現在是否有空。
I will see if we can finish the task early.
我會看看我們是否能提早完成這項任務。
He called to see if the shipment had arrived.
他打電話來看看貨物是否已經送達。

items.colloc: send off to the office 寄送到辦公室 | send off to the client 寄送給客戶
items.distinct: send out 發送 | ship to 運送至
ex: I will send off the contract to the legal department.
我會把合約寄送給法務部門。
Please send off the samples to our partner company.
請將樣品寄送給我們的合作公司。
The documents were sent off to the headquarters yesterday.
文件昨天已經寄送到總部了。

items.colloc: meet a senior executive 會見高階主管 | a senior executive decision 高階主管的決策
items.distinct: middle manager 中階主管 | junior staff 初階員工
ex: The senior executive will host the annual company meeting.
高階主管將主持年度公司會議。
She was promoted to a senior executive position last year.
她去年被晉升為高階主管職位。
We need approval from a senior executive for this budget.
這項預算需要高階主管的核准。

items.colloc: serve a customer promptly 迅速服務顧客 | serve a customer well 妥善服務顧客
items.distinct: assist a client 協助客戶 | handle a complaint 處理投訴
ex: Our staff are trained to serve a customer with care.
我們的員工受過訓練，能用心服務顧客。
It is important to serve a customer in a professional manner.
以專業的態度服務顧客是很重要的。
He is busy serving a customer at the front desk.
他正忙於在櫃檯服務顧客。

items.colloc: set aside funds 撥出資金 | set aside time 撥出時間
items.distinct: put aside 暫時放下 | reserve 預留
ex: We should set aside time to discuss the new strategy.
我們應該撥出時間來討論新策略。
The committee decided to set aside the proposal for now.
委員會決定暫時擱置這項提案。
They have set aside some money for emergency repairs.
他們已經撥出一筆錢用於緊急維修。

items.zh: 開始工作；定下心來工作
items.colloc: set down to work immediately 立即開始工作 | set down to work on the project 開始處理專案
items.distinct: get down to work 開始著手工作 | start working 開始工作
ex: It is time to set down to work on the monthly report.
是時候定下心來處理月度報告了。
They set down to work as soon as the meeting ended.
會議一結束，他們就開始著手工作。
We need to set down to work to meet the deadline.
為了趕上截止日期，我們必須開始認真工作。

items.colloc: set the table for dinner 為晚餐擺放餐具 | help set the table 幫忙擺放餐具
items.distinct: clear the table 收拾餐桌 | arrange the table 安排座位
ex: The waiter is setting the table for the business lunch.
服務生正在為商務午餐擺放餐具。
Please help me set the table before the guests arrive.
請在客人抵達前幫我擺放餐具。
They set the table with fine china for the banquet.
他們為宴會擺放了精緻瓷器餐具。

items.colloc: set up a business 創業 | set up a meeting 安排會議
items.distinct: establish 建立（機構） | arrange 安排（行程）
ex: They plan to set up a new branch in Taipei.
他們計劃在台北設立一家新分公司。
I will set up a conference call for tomorrow morning.
我會為明天早上安排一場電話會議。
The IT department helped set up the new software.
資訊部門協助安裝了新軟體。

items.colloc: successfully set up an interview 成功安排面試 | help set up an interview 協助安排面試
items.distinct: arrange an interview 安排面試 | conduct an interview 進行面試
ex: Human resources will set up an interview with the candidate.
人資部門將會與候選人安排面試。
I managed to set up an interview for next Wednesday.
我設法安排了下週三的面試。
Please set up an interview as soon as you receive the resume.
收到履歷後請儘快安排面試。

items.colloc: like to show off 喜歡炫耀 | show off their skills 炫耀他們的技能
items.distinct: boast 自誇 | display 展示
ex: He likes to show off his expensive office equipment.
他喜歡炫耀他昂貴的辦公設備。
There is no need to show off during the presentation.
簡報時不需要刻意賣弄。
She showed off her new marketing strategy to the team.
她向團隊展示了她新的行銷策略。

items.colloc: take sick leave 請病假 | on sick leave 請病假中
items.distinct: annual leave 年假 | personal leave 事假
ex: He is on sick leave for the rest of the week.
他這週剩下的時間都在請病假。
Please submit your sick leave application through the portal.
請透過系統提交您的病假申請。
She had to take sick leave due to a sudden illness.
由於突發疾病，她必須請病假。

items.colloc: work side by side 並肩工作 | sit side by side 並排坐
items.distinct: together 一起 | alongside 在旁邊
ex: Our departments will work side by side on this project.
我們的部門將會並肩合作完成這個專案。
The two companies are working side by side to innovate.
這兩家公司正並肩合作進行創新。
They sat side by side to review the legal documents.
他們並排坐著審閱法律文件。

items.colloc: unexpected side effect 意想不到的副作用 | manage the side effect 管理副作用
items.distinct: consequence 後果 | secondary effect 次要影響
ex: The new policy had an unintended side effect on morale.
新政策對士氣產生了非預期的副作用。
We must evaluate every potential side effect of this plan.
我們必須評估這項計畫的每一個潛在副作用。
The drug has a mild side effect on some patients.
該藥物對一些病人有輕微的副作用。

items.colloc: sign up for a course 報名課程 | sign up for the newsletter 訂閱電子報
items.distinct: register for 註冊 | enroll in 註冊入學/課程
ex: Many employees signed up for the leadership training program.
許多員工報名參加了領導力培訓計畫。
You can sign up for the seminar on the website.
你可以在網站上報名參加研討會。
She signed up for the newsletter to get industry updates.
她訂閱了電子報以獲取產業最新消息。

items.pos: phr. 耐著性子看完/坐完
items.zh: 耐著性子看完；坐著聽完
items.colloc: sit through a meeting 坐著聽完會議 | sit through the lecture 聽完講座
items.distinct: attend 參加 | endure 忍受
ex: It is difficult to sit through such a long presentation.
要耐著性子聽完這麼長的簡報很困難。
I had to sit through three hours of budget reviews.
我不得不耐著性子參加了三個小時的預算審查。
Everyone had to sit through the boring safety video.
每個人都得耐著性子看完那部無聊的安全影片。

items.colloc: speak on the phone briefly 簡短通話 | speak on the phone about the deal 通電話討論交易
items.distinct: talk on the phone 講電話 | call someone 打電話給某人
ex: I will speak on the phone with the client later.
我稍後會與客戶通電話。
He is busy speaking on the phone regarding the contract.
他正忙著就合約事宜通電話。
We often speak on the phone to coordinate our schedules.
我們常通電話來協調彼此的行程。
